name: dsh-rightbar-tab-width
description: Local persistent Web UI patch: every right-sidebar tab capsule (the dockkit chip carrying data-dockkit-tab) gets a fixed 100px outer width instead of upstream's content-driven 100px-190px float (min-width:80px / max-width:170px / padding:0 10px, content-box). 100px is upstream's own floor, so the capsule is always at its minimum. TypeScript: host half index.ts (type stripping), browser half src/client.ts → lib/client.js (esbuild).
